comparator_type_reading: SMART-C is a consortium's pooled analysis of its own member trials, explicitly not a systematic review: its list is the consortium's membership, not a search result. It is never used as a discovery substitute (no candidate is drawn from it, and our search completeness is never judged against it).

statement.why_not_held: the PMC full text carries no open licence (JAMA); read once to verify, not committed
statement.quote: each included individual trial was funded by industry funders. The EMPA-REG OUTCOME, EMPEROR-Reduced, EMPEROR-Preserved, and EMPA-KIDNEY trials were funded by Boehringer Ingelheim. The CANVAS Program and CREDENCE trials were funded by Janssen Research & Development. The DECLARE-TIMI 58, DAPA-HF, DAPA-CKD, and DELIVER trials were funded by AstraZeneca.

named_membership.reading: Of its 10 member trials, CREDENCE, DAPA-CKD and EMPA-KIDNEY are the three we pool (shared 3 of our 3); the other seven are cardiovascular-outcome and heart-failure trials whose kidney events it re-analyses, outside our CKD entry criterion.

governing.label: SGLT2 inhibitors vs placebo: >=50% eGFR decline, kidney failure or kidney death (cardiovascular death excluded), 10 trials
governing.quote: SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the risk of CKD progression (25.4 vs 40.3 events per 1000 patient-years; hazard ratio [HR], 0.62 [95% CI, 0.57-0.68])

protocol_benchmark.label: served beside our trial-defined primary cardiorenal composite
protocol_benchmark.quote: CKD progression HR 0.62 (95% CI 0.57-0.68) across 10 randomized trials.
protocol_benchmark.why: 0.62 is SMART-C's harmonised kidney-only CKD-progression outcome, not a trial-defined cardiorenal composite; it is kept under its own definition

quotes.quote: CKD progression, defined as kidney failure, at least 50% reduction in eGFR, or death due to kidney failure.

scope.reading: Its CKD-progression outcome is harmonised across trials and excludes cardiovascular death; the external review reports its cardiovascular-death-inclusive result as 0.75 (0.72-0.80) (not in the text we read). Ours are the trials' own cardiorenal composites (0.684) and a kidney-only sensitivity with differing eGFR thresholds (0.651). Neither is the same outcome as its 0.62, so neither agreement nor disagreement validates anything.
scope.reported_by: external review of the sglt2-ckd-progression topic (28 Sep 2026)
